capabilities: Convert Kindle-exported HTML files into Markdown notes
Map Kindle highlight colors to Obsidian callout types
Organize notes by chapter and clean up line breaks
Route generated notes to a configurable, auto-created folder
disambiguation: Converts only Kindle HTML highlight exports into notes; it does not read Kindle ebooks or pull content from a Kindle device.
extras: The manifest notes that this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin is deeply inspired by and upgraded from the excellent work of l2xu/kindle_html_importer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Kindle-exported HTML highlight files into clean, organized Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: deeply inspired by and upgraded from the excellent work of l2xu/kindle_html_importer

summary: Kindle HTML note importer that converts exported Kindle highlight files into formatted Markdown notes with callouts and nested blockquotes.
